Apparently the one thing AI can never replace...

...is networking.

So I guess the secret to your career isn't your skills, your experience, or your work anymore.

It's "coffee chats"

In this video, we take a look at another round of LinkedIn leadership advice about networking, trust, relationships, and why "it's who you know" is apparently the future of work.

Nothing motivates college students quite like spending four years earning a degree just to be told the real secret was networking all along.
title: WHY CORPORATE "LEADERSHIP ADVICE" IS A JOKE!
